title: For carcinogenic molecules containing nitrogen and having triple bonds, wha
question: For carcinogenic molecules containing nitrogen and having triple bonds, what is the percentage of carbon atoms? Also identify the molecule with the most triple bonds among these.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM atom a
          WHERE a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
            AND a.XCL_003 = 'n'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM bond b
          WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
            AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
      )
),
triple_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.XCL_004) AS triple_bond_count
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
      AND b.XCL_005 IN (SELECT XCL_010 FROM eligible_molecules)
    GROUP BY b.XCL_005
),
carbon_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS carbon_percentage
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.XCL_002 IN (SELECT XCL_010 FROM eligible_molecules)
)
SELECT 
    cs.carbon_percentage,
    tb.molecule_id
FROM carbon_stats cs
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM triple_bond_counts
    ORDER BY triple_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) tb

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH eligible_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM atom a
          WHERE a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
            AND a.XCL_003 = 'n'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM bond b
          WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
            AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
      )
),
triple_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.XCL_004) AS triple_bond_count
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
      AND b.XCL_005 IN (SELECT XCL_010 FROM eligible_molecules)
    GROUP BY b.XCL_005
),
carbon_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS carbon_percentage
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.XCL_002 IN (SELECT XCL_010 FROM eligible_molecules)
)
SELECT 
    cs.carbon_percentage,
    tb.molecule_id
FROM carbon_stats cs
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM triple_bond_counts
    ORDER BY triple_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) tb

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT 
    m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS carbon_percentage
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a_n WHERE a_n.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 AND a_n.XCL_003 = 'n')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b_t WHERE b_t.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010 AND b_t.XCL_006 = '#')
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
ORDER BY (
    SELECT COUNT(b.XCL_004) 
    FROM bond b 
    WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010 
    AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH target_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    JOIN connected c ON b.XCL_004 = c.XCL_009
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'N'
      AND c.XCL_008 = a.XCL_001
      AND c.XCL_007 IN (
          SELECT a2.XCL_001
          FROM atom a2
          JOIN connected c2 ON a2.XCL_001 = c2.XCL_008
          WHERE c2.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
      )
      AND c.XCL_007 IN (
          SELECT a3.XCL_001
          FROM atom a3
          JOIN connected c3 ON a3.XCL_001 = c3.XCL_008
          WHERE c3.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM connected c1
          JOIN connected c2 ON c1.XCL_009 = c2.XCL_009
          WHERE c1.XCL_008 = c.XCL_008
            AND c2.XCL_008 = c.XCL_007
            AND c1.XCL_009 = c.XCL_009
      )
),
triple_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.XCL_004) AS triple_bond_count
    FROM target_molecules tm
    JOIN molecule m ON tm.XCL_010 = m.XCL_010
    JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    JOIN connected c1 ON b.XCL_004 = c1.XCL_009
    JOIN connected c2 ON b.XCL_004 = c2.XCL_009
    WHERE c1.XCL_008 != c2.XCL_008
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
),
carbon_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010,
        COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS carbon_count
    FROM target_molecules tm
    JOIN molecule m ON tm.XCL_010 = m.XCL_010
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'C'
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
),
total_atom_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010,
        COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS total_atom_count
    FROM target_molecules tm
    JOIN molecule m ON tm.XCL_010 = m.XCL_010
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (SELECT SUM(cc.carbon_count) FROM carbon_counts cc) * 100.0 / 
        (SELECT SUM(tac.total_atom_count) FROM total_atom_counts tac),
        2
    ) AS carbon_percentage,
    (
        SELECT m.XCL_010

        ORDER BY tbc.triple_bond_count DESC
        LIMIT 1

FROM target_molecules
LIMIT 1
